body.message:
We have checked with the management, and unfortunately, we are unable to reduce the security deposit amount further, as the current amount is already a reduced rate. Please note that the security deposit is a mandatory requirement as part of the check-in process.

Regarding your request for early access, unfortunately, we are unable to provide access to the unit before the confirmed check-in date.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and greatly appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
